answer: Verifiable Physical Corridor: each agent must periodically traverse a unique physical bridge or jetty fitted with tamper-evident sensors, generating a signed location-timing trace. Faking N identities requires N simultaneous physical presences and N sensor-compliant transits; costs scale as hardware, logistics, and travel time, not just computation.
